items.name: Text-to-Music-and-Text-to-Image-Generator
items.description: This is a web-based multipage application developed using Streamlit to create music and images based on user input. Text-to-Music generation is enabled through the utilization of Facebook's pre-trained model musicgen-small, and Text-to-Image Generation is facilitated using an open-source pre-trained model: CompVis/stable-diffusion-v1-4.
